prompt: An oil painting depicts a warm living room during a family gathering, rendered with thick brushstrokes and rich colors. In the center, a grandmother in a floral dress sits on a plush sofa, holding a baby wrapped in a white blanket. The baby reaches out toward a toddler standing nearby, who holds a wooden toy block. To the left, a father in a sweater pours tea from a ceramic pot into cups held by two children seated on the floor. The children look up at him with anticipation. On the right, an aunt arranges plates of cookies on a coffee table, leaning slightly forward as she places the last cookie. A grandfather stands behind the sofa, resting his hand on the grandmother’s shoulder while smiling at the scene. A cat sleeps curled up on a rug in the foreground, near a pair of discarded shoes. Bookshelves line the back wall, filled with leather-bound books and framed photographs. Soft light from a fireplace illuminates the room, casting a golden glow on the faces and furniture. The atmosphere is intimate and joyful, with every element contributing to a sense of closeness and tradition. The style emphasizes texture and depth through layered paint and subtle shading.
